literal: The gracious ones, those who are called, are the righteous ones, indeed, towards all living beings pure compassion having taken upon oneself because of conducting.
translation: Those who are called sages are the truly righteous ones, because they conduct themselves with pure compassion towards all living beings.
modern: எல்லா உயிர்களிடத்தும் சிறந்த இரக்கத்தை மேற்கொண்டு நடப்பதால், அறவோர்களே அந்தணர் என்று அழைக்கப்படுவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet defines the true nature of a sage or a gracious person. The word 'antaṇar' literally implies those possessing a beautiful, cool, and compassionate nature. The poet asserts that true sages are simply the righteous ones who extend pure compassion to every living being. Their greatness is not determined by birth or appearance, but by their unwavering kindness and ethical conduct towards all life.
